1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 45 cm de longitud, con aletas radiadas y cuerpo comprimido lateralmente, de color amarillo ribeteado de un azul intenso. Pomacanthidae, Holacanthus ciliaris.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 45 cm in length, with radiated fins and laterally compressed body, featuring a yellow coloration bordered by intense blue. Family Pomacanthidae, species Holacanthus ciliaris.
